description: National Cancer Institute Genomic Data Commons TCGA Lung Adenocarcinoma PanCancer Atlas public dataset containing clinical characteristics, pathological staging, smoking history, and somatic mutation calls.
relevant_features: bcr_patient_barcode, age, sex, race, ajcc_pathologic_stage, tobacco_smoking_history, pack_years_smoked, os_months, os_status, pfs_months, pfs_status, hugo_symbol, variant_classification, hgvsp_short, vaf
license_or_usage_note: Open Access / Public Domain (Creative Commons Zero CC0)
license_access_information: Open Access / Public Domain (Creative Commons Zero CC0)
limitations: Exome sequencing from primary resected untreated tumors; metastatic and post-treatment longitudinal biopsies are limited; ctDNA and PD-L1 TPS IHC not systematically assayed in original freeze.
provenance_reference_citation: The Cancer Genome Atlas Research Network. Comprehensive molecular profiling of lung adenocarcinoma. Nature 511, 543-550 (2014). DOI:10.1038/nature13385

description: National Cancer Institute Genomic Data Commons TCGA Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma PanCancer Atlas public dataset with staging, histopathology, smoking burden, and somatic variant profiles.
cancer_type: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (Squamous Cell Carcinoma)
relevant_features: bcr_patient_barcode, age, sex, race, ajcc_pathologic_stage, tobacco_smoking_history, pack_years_smoked, os_months, os_status, pfs_months, pfs_status, hugo_symbol, variant_classification, hgvsp_short, vaf
license_or_usage_note: Open Access / Public Domain (Creative Commons Zero CC0)
license_access_information: Open Access / Public Domain (Creative Commons Zero CC0)
limitations: Predominantly localized/resectable surgical cohort; limited longitudinal treatment resistance data; targeted TKI resistance mutations rare due to squamous histology.
provenance_reference_citation: The Cancer Genome Atlas Research Network. Comprehensive genomic characterization of squamous cell lung cancers. Nature 489, 519-525 (2012). DOI:10.1038/nature11404

dataset_name: MSK-IMPACT NSCLC Targeted Sequencing & Resistance Cohort
description: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center clinical targeted sequencing cohort (MSK-IMPACT 341/410/468-gene panel) of advanced/metastatic NSCLC patients with targeted therapy, resistance alterations, TMB, and response.
relevant_features: patient_id, age, sex, cancer_stage, histology, primary_driver_gene, primary_mutation, secondary_resistance_mutation, prior_targeted_therapy, best_recist_response, tmb_score, pdl1_tps_percent, ctdna_maf_percent, resistance_mechanism
license_or_usage_note: Open Access via cBioPortal (CC BY-NC 4.0 / AACR Project GENIE Data Use Agreement)
license_access_information: Open Access via cBioPortal (CC BY-NC 4.0 / AACR Project GENIE Data Use Agreement)
limitations: Targeted gene panel rather than whole-exome sequencing; predominantly advanced/metastatic setting; selected for patients undergoing molecular profiling at tertiary cancer center.
provenance_reference_citation: Zehir A et al. Mutational landscape of metastatic cancer revealed from prospective clinical sequencing of 10,000 patients. Nat Med 23, 703-713 (2017); Rizvi NA et al. Mutational landscape determines sensitivity to PD-1 blockade in non-small cell lung cancer. Science 348, 124-128 (2015).

dataset_name: SEER 18/21 Cancer Statistics Review (Lung and Bronchus)
description: National Cancer Institute Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) Program population-based cancer registry providing real-world demographic, stage distribution, and 5-year relative survival rates.
relevant_features: age_group, sex, stage_distribution_percent, five_year_survival_percent, incidence_rate_per_100k, median_age_at_diagnosis
limitations: Population registry lacks individual patient-level genomic variant profiles, ctDNA values, and granular targeted therapy response data.
provenance_reference_citation: National Cancer Institute. SEER Cancer Statistics Review 1975-2020. Surveillance Research Program, NCI (2023). Available at https://seer.cancer.gov

dataset_name: CIViC & ClinVar Curated NSCLC Somatic Resistance Registry
description: Clinical Interpretations of Variants in Cancer (CIViC) and NCBI ClinVar somatic curated databases detailing evidence levels for NSCLC driver, co-occurring, and drug-resistance mutations.
relevant_features: gene, variant, hgvsp, therapy_associated, resistance_type, evidence_level, clinical_significance, pubmed_id, citation
limitations: Curated knowledgebase of published clinical and preclinical evidence rather than prospective continuous patient cohorts; frequencies depend on publication bias.
provenance_reference_citation: Griffith M et al. CIViC is a community knowledgebase for expert crowdsourcing the clinical interpretation of variants in cancer. Nat Genet 49, 170-174 (2017); Landrum MJ et al. ClinVar: improvements to access, content and standards. Nucleic Acids Res 48, D835-D844 (2020).

dataset_name: Curated Oncology Biomarker Clinical Trial Evidence
description: Curated published clinical trial cutoffs and benchmark response thresholds for PD-L1, TMB, ctDNA MAF, NLR, CRP, and LDH in NSCLC.
relevant_features: biomarker_name, clinical_context, measurement_unit, reference_range_or_categories, median_observed, iqr_range_q1_q3, clinical_cutoff, interpretation_and_utility, source_study_doi
limitations: Literature-derived trial benchmarks and consensus cutoffs rather than continuous individual patient level measurements.
provenance_reference_citation: Reck M et al. NEJM 2016; Marabelle A et al. Lancet Oncol 2020; Abbosh C et al. Nature 2017
